facts.label: Serviço de quarto
facts.sub: Nos hotéis dos EUA, você liga da própria linha do quarto, em geral discando 9 ou 0, e pede comida, toalhas e outros itens.

facts.label: Número do quarto
facts.sub: Diga sempre o número do quarto primeiro, assim: This is room six twelve. É o que o funcionário precisa para saber aonde levar o seu pedido.

pages.title: Dial 9 · 1/3
paragraphs: It is nine at night in a big hotel in Las Vegas. Dani sits on the bed after a long trip. She is tired, hungry and a little cold. She looks at the phone next to the lamp. A card says “Room Service: dial 9”. She picks up the phone and dials.
“Room service. How can I help you?” says Lou. “Hello. This is room six twelve.” says Dani. “Good evening. What do you need?” says Lou.
pages.prompt: Onde começa e o que acontece?

pages.title: Dial 9 · 3/3
paragraphs: “Perfect. Also, the air conditioner is too cold.” says Dani. “I’ll send someone to check it. Thank you.” says Lou. Twenty minutes later, someone knocks on the door. A waiter pushes a small cart with her dinner. He also brings two clean towels. A technician comes and fixes the air conditioner. Dani eats on a small table by the window. Good service makes a hotel feel like home.
